# Meridian Gray

> Meridian Gray is a full-stack business-systems agency based in Kolkata, India. We design, build and automate connected systems — websites, CRM/ERP, automation and marketing — for growing businesses across India, delivered as one connected system rather than disconnected tools.

Meridian Gray runs a free 5-minute Business Health Check that scores a company's sales, operations and marketing setup and returns the three fixes to make first. Contact: info@meridiangray.in, +91-79729-21514, Office 215, Center Point, 21 Hemanta Basu Sarani, Lal Dighi, B.B.D. Bagh, Kolkata 700001, India.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.meridiangray.in/): Connect your sales, operations and marketing into one system. Meridian Gray designs, builds and automates business systems. Take the 5-minute health check.
- [What We Do](https://www.meridiangray.in/services): Research, design, development, automation and marketing, delivered as one connected system for your business. See how Meridian Gray works and what we build.
- [What We Think (Insights/Blog index)](https://www.meridiangray.in/what-we-think): Practical guides, frameworks and reports on enquiries, automation, search visibility and connected systems, written from the work we do with growing businesses.
- [What We've Done (Case Studies & Portfolio)](https://www.meridiangray.in/what-weve-done): Case studies from Printingz, TechAssures, AECCORE and Buraq AI: before-and-after results, live products and the systems we built for growing businesses.
- [Business Health Check (free diagnostic tool)](https://www.meridiangray.in/where-you-stand): Find out what is really holding your business back. A 5-minute health check built for your industry, with a clear score and the three fixes to make first.
- [Who We Are](https://www.meridiangray.in/about): Meet the two founders behind Meridian Gray: business thinking and design combined to build systems that work in the real world. Our story, approach and values.
- [Contact](https://www.meridiangray.in/where-to-find-us): Tell us what is slowing your business down. Email, call or WhatsApp Meridian Gray, send a 2-minute brief, or visit us at Center Point, B.B.D. Bagh, Kolkata.
